d: GTA VI fever has reached the sporting world, and even some of the biggest names in sport cannot seem to get enough of Grand Theft Auto VI. Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen, Kimi Antonelli and Conor McGregor are among the stars caught up in the excitement, while NFL star Tyreek Hill has an even closer connection to the game. Rupha Ramani looks at how GTA VI has become a sporting and cultural phenomenon.
